source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.30
text: Seed fields go through a defined sequence of five field inspections (អធិការកិច្ចតាមស្រែ) timed to the crop's growth stages, run in parallel with Farmer Field School (FFS) sessions: Field Inspection 1 — around the nursery/germination and early establishment stage; Field Inspection 2 — roughly 30–50 days after transplanting (vegetative/tillering stage); Field Inspection 3 — around the flowering/heading stage; Field Inspection 4 — roughly 5–10 days before harvest maturity (near-maturity stage); and a fifth, final inspection of the harvested/output seed lot itself (production-output inspection). Each inspection has its own pass/fail criteria specific to that growth stage (see the detailed field-inspection-criteria records for registered and certified seed classes).
